sex-age.summary: Viewed close, surface carries age: overblending makes a man younger and can make him a boy; keep in-focus texture and fine lines, add a few indented grey hairs where focus allows, avoid over-ageing; never trace a real person's photograph (at this fidelity it is a likeness).

rules.rule: Keep skin texture and fine lines at the photographic level in focus; smoothing makes a face younger.
rules.source: docs/subjects/sex-age.md section 4 (Fink and Matts 2008; Burt and Perrett 1995; Porcheron et al. 2013; Panhard et al. 2012)

rules.rule: Grey hairs are reserved white: indent before tone, or lift last with an electric eraser at 2-3 px; mid-forties is a little grey at most.
rules.source: Skillshare, Drawing Realistic Hair and Beard with Graphite (lesson notes): https://www.skillshare.com/en/classes/drawing-realistic-hair-and-beard-with-graphite/1384601388; docs/styles/graphite-hyperrealism.md section 8; docs/subjects/sex-age.md section 4 (Fink and Matts 2008; Burt and Perrett 1995; Porcheron et al. 2013; Panhard et al. 2012)

rules.rule: Put the grey where the focus can carry it (stubble near the focal plane); out-of-focus hair cannot show single grey hairs.
rules.source: judgement from Wikipedia, Depth of field: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Depth_of_field

rules.rule: Expression folds (crow's feet, nasolabial fold) crisp; age-only folds (jowls, marionette lines, neck bands, age spots) absent or faint for mid-forties.
Male cues from structure: brow ridge, jaw angle, thick neck, beard-zone tone and stubble; moderate eye and lip contrast.
Pore size grows from the youngest group and plateaus from about 40: a mid-forties face has visible fine texture on cheek and nose.
rules.source: Flament et al. 2015, Facial skin pores, CCID: https://www.dovepress.com/facial-skin-pores-a-multiethnic-study-peer-reviewed-fulltext-article-CCID

rules.rule: The reference is a rendered or invented face, varied from the studio's defaults; never a traced photograph of a real person, no identifying marks.

keep: layer 1 structure cues and their weights
thumbnail legibility of adult man from structure and hair value
avoid: over-ageing with deep folds and grey
a traced photograph of a real man
large eyes and a smooth jaw
flags: The brief's grey hairs conflict with out-of-focus hair: the grey moves to the stubble near the focal plane.
sources: Flament et al. 2015, Facial skin pores, CCID: https://www.dovepress.com/facial-skin-pores-a-multiethnic-study-peer-reviewed-fulltext-article-CCID
